name: Mia Thompson
story: Mia was diagnosed with Tetralogy of Fallot during a prenatal ultrasound. After her complete repair surgery at 5 months old, her parents were told she might face physical limitations. Today, Mia plays on her school soccer team and scored her first goal last spring.

name: Ethan Rodriguez
diagnosis: Tetralogy of Fallot with Pulmonary Atresia
story: Ethan underwent three open-heart surgeries before his third birthday. Doctors were unsure if he would lead a normal life. In May 2025, Ethan graduated with honors from university with a degree in Biomedical Engineering, inspired by the doctors who saved his life.

name: Baby Ava Chen
story: Ava's parents discovered her heart condition at the 20-week anatomy scan. After months of preparation and prayer, Ava had her complete intracardiac repair at 6 months old. She is now thriving, hitting every developmental milestone, and charming everyone with her smile.

name: James Okonkwo
story: Repaired at 2 years old in the 1990s, James was always told to take it easy. With clearance from his adult congenital heart cardiologist and years of careful training, James completed his first half marathon, proving that Heart Warriors can achieve extraordinary things.

name: Lily Fernandez
story: After two surgeries and countless hospital visits, Lily walked into her preschool classroom with a sparkly backpack and the biggest grin. Her mom says that watching Lily wave goodbye and run to play with the other kids was the moment she knew everything would be okay.

name: Noah and Sarah Kim
story: After navigating Daniel's diagnosis, two surgeries, and the emotional rollercoaster of CHD parenting, Noah and Sarah started a local Heart Warrior support group. They now help over 40 families in their community find hope, resources, and friendship during the hardest times.
